columns.comment: Core-banking account id (join gold.dim_account).
columns.name: account_id

columns.comment: Calendar day of the end-of-day balance (every day incl. weekends; 1-Dec-2025 to 30-Sep-2026).
columns.name: balance_date

columns.comment: First day of the calendar month of balance_date.
columns.name: month

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Core-banking customer number (source identity record) holding the account.
columns.name: cust_no

columns.comment: APAC booking location of the account = the holder's coverage office (ISO-2, e.g. HK); join gold.dim_booking_entity.
columns.name: booking_country

columns.comment: Current Account, Savings Account, Time Deposit or Money Market Deposit.
columns.name: account_type

columns.comment: Deposit product (PRD-CURRENT-ACCOUNT, PRD-SAVINGS-ACCOUNT, PRD-TIME-DEPOSIT, PRD-MONEY-MARKET-DEPOSIT); join gold.dim_product.
columns.name: product_id

columns.comment: CASA (current and savings accounts) or TD (time and money-market deposits).
columns.name: deposit_class

columns.comment: True for current / savings accounts (CASA); CASA ratio = CASA balance / total balance on one date.
columns.name: is_casa

columns.comment: ISO 4217 currency of the account (balance_lcy is in this currency).
columns.name: currency

columns.comment: End-of-day balance in the account currency (point-in-time; >= 0; do not sum across dates).
columns.name: balance_lcy

columns.comment: End-of-day balance in USD at the day's FX rate (point-in-time; >= 0; do not sum across dates).
columns.name: balance_usd

columns.comment: balance_usd when the account is CASA, else 0 (point-in-time). CASA ratio = SUM(casa_balance_usd) / SUM(balance_usd) on one date.
columns.name: casa_balance_usd

columns.comment: balance_usd when the account is a time / money-market deposit, else 0 (point-in-time).
columns.name: td_balance_usd

columns.comment: USD balance of the same account on the previous day (null on the account's first day in the window).
columns.name: balance_usd_prev_day

columns.comment: USD balance of the same account 30 days earlier (null when the account or the window is younger than 30 days). 30-day outflow % = 1 - SUM(balance_usd) / SUM(balance_usd_30d_prior).
columns.name: balance_usd_30d_prior

columns.comment: balance_usd - balance_usd_prev_day (USD; negative = outflow); additive across accounts and days (a flow).
columns.name: balance_change_1d_usd

columns.comment: Principal (USD) of time deposits placed into this TD / money-market account on this day (flow; 0 for CASA or no placement).
columns.name: td_placed_usd

columns.comment: Part of td_placed_usd funded by a transfer from the client's current account (CASA -> TD migration), USD (flow).
columns.name: td_placed_from_current_account_usd

columns.comment: On current accounts: principal moved out of this account into time deposits on this day (funding account of the placement), USD (flow).
columns.name: transferred_to_td_usd

columns.comment: Principal (USD) of time deposits on this account maturing on this day (flow).
columns.name: td_matured_usd

columns.comment: True on the last calendar day of a month - the month-end snapshot (equals fact_deposit_balance_monthly).
columns.name: is_month_end

columns.comment: True on the as-of date 30-Sep-2026 (today's balance).
columns.name: is_as_of_date

columns.comment: True on a Singapore business day (Mon-Fri); weekend balances repeat the Friday balance.
columns.name: is_business_day_sg

comment: Daily end-of-day deposit balances per core-banking account for the 10-month daily window 1-Dec-2025 to 30-Sep-2026 (current, savings, time-deposit and money-market accounts), in local currency and USD, with the CASA / TD split, the balance 1 and 30 days earlier (outflow analysis, e.g. Sunda's February outflow) and the day's time-deposit placements / maturities. POINT-IN-TIME: never sum balances across dates - take one date (is_as_of_date, is_month_end) or the average over days. Month-end rows equal fact_deposit_balance_monthly; history before Dec-2025 is month-end only (fact_deposit_balance_monthly). Grain: one row per account per calendar day (1-Dec-2025 to 30-Sep-2026, from the account's first day).
